about: Accomplished and pioneering Platform Engineer with a proven track record of building and scaling cloud infrastructure from the ground up. Expertise in leading cloud modernization initiatives, migrating from legacy systems to scalable, container-based solutions on AWS. Passionate about empowering development teams by reducing friction through strategic technology adoption (Terraform, Pulumi) and fostering a culture of observability and SRE best practices.

highlights: Architected and led the migration from a legacy VM-based architecture to a modern, scalable containerized platform on AWS ECS, enabling product teams to self-sufficiently create and deploy new services within 6 months.

Spearheaded the company-wide adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), initially with Terraform and later leading the strategic transition to Pulumi (TypeScript) to align with the primary codebase, significantly reducing developer friction and increasing contributions to infrastructure modules.
Played an instrumental role in building the Platform team from the ground up, defining the hiring process and leading the interviews that scaled the team.
Established a robust observability culture by implementing monitoring-as-code, alarms, and integrating SRE principles (SLIs, SLOs) into the product development lifecycle.
Enhanced the company's data infrastructure by migrating the data platform to Kubernetes (EKS) and ensuring adherence to GDPR data compliance standards.
Developed and maintained CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, automating builds, testing, and deployments to improve release velocity and reliability.
Automated infrastructure provisioning and configuration for containerized applications on AWS, ensuring adherence to security best practices and compliance standards.
Monitored system health and performance to guarantee high uptime, responding to incidents as part of an on-call rotation.
Managed cloud resources and infrastructure using IaC tools including AWS CloudFormation and Terraform.
Designed and developed responsive, high-performance web platforms for financial blogging and consulting.
Built robust and scalable web applications for enterprise use, focusing on clean architecture and maintainability.
